level_meanings.0: exact retained length, same activity bucket, same recency bucket
level_meanings.1: exact retained length and activity bucket; recency bucket relaxed
level_meanings.2: exact retained length only; activity and recency buckets relaxed
level_meanings.3: donor retained length at least the target's; never used, zero rows

terminology: bucket_relaxation is the stored `fallback` column; it denotes donor bucket relaxation only, never a length mismatch or an invalid donor
